'''Mako Hyōdō''' (Japanese: '''兵藤まこ''' ''Hyōdō Mako'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Hyōdō was born on September 7, 1962 in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. Hyōdō provided voices for the {{pkmn|animated series}} since the {{aniseries|OS}}, starting from a few [[Character of the day|characters of the day]], but her most prominent roles are those of [[James's parents|James's]] and [[Lola|Brock's mothers]]. She is currently affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|81 Produce}}.
